item.name: Make Coffee
item.startObject: Coffee packet on the kitchen island
item.howToComplete: Carry the packet to the coffee maker by the sink, use the arrows to hold the needle in the green zone, then wait for brewing to finish.
item.cardSummary: Island packet to the sink-side coffee maker. Lock the needle in the green zone and stay until brewing actually ends.

item.name: Do the Dishes
item.startObject: Plate stack on the kitchen island
item.howToComplete: Carry each plate to the sink and finish the wash input before grabbing the next one. Keep going until the stack is gone.
item.cardSummary: Move island plates to the sink one at a time and finish washing each plate before you leave.

item.name: Cook Tomorrow's Lunch
item.startObject: Pan and pasta on the kitchen island
item.howToComplete: Take the pan to the stove, cook the pasta while keeping the dial in the green zone, then store the finished lunch in the fridge.
item.cardSummary: Cook the island pasta on the stove until the green-zone minigame ends, then put the lunch in the fridge.

item.name: Clean the Kitchen
item.startObject: Squirt bottle on the kitchen island
item.howToComplete: Spray and clear the kitchen stains, including easy-to-miss spots by the island chairs and the fridge.
item.cardSummary: Grab the island bottle and wipe every kitchen stain, then recheck the chairs and fridge if the task stays open.

item.name: Clear Spider Webs
item.howToComplete: Walk the doorways and hold the clean prompt on each web until it disappears.
item.cardSummary: Sweep every doorway and hold the web prompt through the full clear instead of tapping once.

item.name: Clean the Windows
item.startObject: Dirty windows in the living room and hall
item.howToComplete: Interact with each pane and keep scrubbing until the dirt is gone, then move to the next window.
item.cardSummary: Clean living-room and hall windows fully. One animation is not enough if dirt remains.

item.name: Water the Plants
item.startObject: Watering can by the front living-room window
item.howToComplete: Pick up the can and water the houseplants in the living room, hallway, and bathroom until the objective clears.
item.cardSummary: Grab the front-room watering can and hit every indoor plant on a living-room, hall, and bathroom sweep.

item.name: Clean Your Room
item.startObject: Toys and crayons on the bedroom floor
item.howToComplete: Pick up the floor clutter in the first left-hand hallway bedroom and place it in the toy box until the prompt completes.
item.cardSummary: Your room is the first hallway bedroom on the left. Toys and crayons go in the toy box, not next to it.

item.name: Clean Your Parents' Room
item.startObject: Clothes on the floor and bed
item.howToComplete: Carry the clothes into the laundry basket in the parents' bedroom at the end of the hall.
item.cardSummary: The end-of-hall bedroom is laundry, not the cat check. Clothes from the floor and bed go in the basket.
